extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath process execution view for the Benefit Claims Processing workflow, with the BPMN-style flow diagram on the canvas and the execution trail/variables panels open at the bottom. The Residency Verification Agent activity inside the “Fraud research agents” group is selected and highlighted with a red box. In the Variables tab, the selected agent’s output variables show a rationale indicating a residency record was found and a ResidencyValida value of “Valid.”
